_comment: Pinned facts for the azure-iac-terraform fixture. Every entry is a decision where a plausible improvisation and the correct answer DIVERGE — a fact the model would get wrong by reasoning from the Terraform alone instead of consulting arm-type-canonicalization.md and extract-terraform.md. Facts a model gets right by accident are deliberately not asserted here; they cost review attention and prove nothing.

resource_counts._comment: 28 resource blocks; azurerm_dev_test_lab is untranslated and therefore skipped, not guessed.

canonical_types._comment: Keyed by the Terraform local name. Casing is asserted exactly.

forbidden_types._comment: Plausible guesses that are not real ARM type strings, or are the wrong casing. None may appear as any resource's azure_type.

function_app._comment: The sharpest trap: a function app is a sites resource discriminated by kind, and Microsoft.Web/functionApps does not exist.

azure_id._comment: Terraform carries no ARM IDs, so these are reconstructed. The resource-group form is the exception that carries no /providers/ segment.

app_service_plan_fan_in._comment: THE 5x cost trap. Five apps share one S1 plan with worker_count 2. A per-app mapping would emit five compute line items downstream; the hosted_on edges are what prevent it. Asserted at Discover because by Design it is already too late to recover the edge.

cross_resource_group_edge._comment: The app lives in rg-app, its database in rg-data. RG-seeded clustering alone would split them; this edge is what later merges them. An extractor that drops edges crossing a group boundary fails here.

private_endpoint._comment: Edge-bearing config source, not a mapping target: inventoried so it can be reported as skipped, but its value is the private_link edge to the resource it fronts.

secrets._comment: Hard boundary. The corpus carries a greppable sentinel in three places: two app_settings values and a VM admin_password. None may appear anywhere in the artifact, not even redacted in place — a redaction placeholder still discloses that the field existed.

untranslated_types._comment: azurerm_dev_test_lab is deliberately absent from arm-type-canonicalization.md. It must be reported, not guessed: a guessed type fails silently against every downstream mapping table.

unresolved_modules._comment: A registry module whose content is not in the workspace. Silence here is how a Terraform-only inventory ends up confidently missing a third of the estate.

routing_discriminators._comment: Attributes that are the sole input to a later rubric decision. Dropping one does not fail any shape assertion — it just makes the rubric guess.

forbidden_artifact_substrings._comment: Terraform type strings must never survive into the artifact; the canonical vocabulary is ARM.
